key_insight: MTP speedups in RL are limited by rising entropy, and Bebop restores acceptance by pairing rejection sampling with an end-to-end TV loss.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical recipe to keep rollout acceleration effective during large-scale RL training, improving throughput without frequent online MTP retuning.
method: Measure how RL-induced entropy changes affect MTP acceptance.
Use probabilistic rejection sampling instead of greedy draft sampling.
Train MTP with an end-to-end TV loss to directly optimize multi-step acceptance.
evidence_signal: Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and agentic tasks, the method raises acceptance rates by about 10%, reaches up to 95% acceptance, and improves async RL end-to-end throughput by up to 1.8x.
watch_item: The gains depend on stable entropy behavior and careful integration of rejection sampling, so performance may vary across models and RL regimes.
paper_title: Breaking Entropy Bounds: Accelerating RL Training via MTP with Rejection Sampling
